values.value: Finds: Inactive SBQQ__ApprovalRule__c records lingering in the org. Why it matters: Inactive rules clutter Setup, slow down admin searches, and confuse new team members trying to map the active approval matrix. They also represent technical debt that grows silently over time. Suppress a finding: when a rule is intentionally parked inactive pending a planned reactivation (seasonal promotion, anticipated reorg). Note the reactivation date. Disable the detector: only if your team intentionally keeps a deep history of inactive rules for audit purposes. Most orgs should leave this on.
